feat(mainnet+bot): fresh mainnet proof under fixed contract, /importkey

Landing page FAQ now links a mainnet deploy + guarded spend performed
under the agent_pkh-fixed validator, replacing the links to the old
vulnerable contract's transactions from before the fix.

Telegram bot: added /importkey <privateKey> [perTxCap] [dailyCap] so
a user can register with a key they already control instead of only
being offered one the bot generates. The bot still signs on their
behalf during use - that part is unavoidable for a chat interface with
no wallet-extension access - but the user now always has their own
copy of the key from the start rather than depending on bot storage
for it. Best-effort deletes the message containing the raw key.

refactor(api): remove deprecated adaTxHash field from Swap model

The adaTxHash field is no longer needed as fee transactions are now tracked separately via feeTxHash and related fields. This commit removes it from the Prisma schema and the API query.

fix: auth bugs, wallet swap UX, and add Vitest test suite

- Fix logout cookie not clearing (missing path: '/' on clearAuthCookie)
- Fix /api/auth/me missing onboarded field; LoginPanel now respects it
- Fix Twitter callback routing: onboarded check no longer includes name
- Fix WalletConnectButton: userDisconnected ref prevents auto-retrigger
- Make wallet address permanent on profile (remove disconnect button)
- Fix get-shell-user to use network-aware DB instead of hardcoded preprod
- Fix swap request modal: silent CIP-30 probe resolves CCWW race condition
  so wallet-type users are no longer told to connect from Profile
- Add reconnect widget in UserProfileDialog when extension genuinely offline
- Add Vitest suite: 58 tests across jwt, cookies, skills, proxy, API routes
- Exclude tests/ from main tsconfig; add tsconfig.test.json for Vitest alias resolution

fix: use 'link' mode instead of 'login' for wallet connect on profile page

The profile page was using mode='login' which triggered the full auth
flow (connectAndAuth), redirecting to /migrating upon successful wallet
sign-in. Changed to mode='link' which calls connectAndLink — the
correct flow for attaching a wallet to an already-authenticated user.

Also added onLinked callback to re-fetch the profile so the newly linked
wallet address appears immediately.

Staging

refactor: remove claim/drop task actions, simplify submission flow

Eliminate the separate claim step from the task workflow. Users now submit work directly without a prior claim, and submissions are no longer reserved. Multiple users can submit for the same task until the poster approves one. Update UI components to reflect the new flow (remove `slotsRemaining`, add `submissionCount`) and adjust all tests accordingly.

feat: implement closeMission action with shared refund logic

Extract refund logic from processDeadlineRefund into a reusable function closeAndRefundUnfilled, used by both deadline cron and poster's manual close. Add tests for closeMission covering unfilled slots, partial approvals, rejection of submissions, and refund safety. This ensures consistent refund handling and prevents double refunds.
